Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

QuantifyPolyA 0.4.0

Breaking / behaviour changes

  • Remove.IP() and is.internal.priming() gain three arguments controlling their internal priming detection: flank_len (default 15), win_size (default 10) and min_A (default 8). The detection window is now coord +/- flank_len and the threshold is min_A adenines in a sliding window of win_size bases, replacing the previously hard-coded coord +/- 10 / >=7 / window 10.
  • Because the defaults changed, results from Remove.IP() are not identical to version 0.3.0. To reproduce the old behaviour use Remove.IP(QpolyA, fasta, flank_len = 10, win_size = 10, min_A = 7).

Dependency changes

  • makeTxDbFromGFF() moved from GenomicFeatures to the txdbmaker package in Bioconductor 3.19 and was removed from GenomicFeatures in 3.23. polyAsite.annotation() now calls txdbmaker::makeTxDbFromGFF(), and txdbmaker is a new dependency.
  • All packages moved from Depends to Imports. library(QuantifyPolyA) no longer attaches DESeq2, ggplot2, dplyr and the other dependencies to the search path.
  • rtracklayer is no longer a dependency; it is only needed to import a GTF for the examples in the vignette and is now listed under Suggests.
  • utils, stats, methods and grDevices are now imported explicitly.

Package infrastructure

  • Added Authors@R, URL, BugReports, Remotes and VignetteBuilder.
  • Added a package vignette based on the SourceForge user manual.
  • Added README.md, NEWS.md and GitHub Actions workflows for R CMD check and pkgdown.
  • Removed the top-level if (!require(...)) install.packages(...) calls from the package source; installing packages during R CMD INSTALL is not allowed and these calls never ran for users installing the built package.
  • Version numbering: the package now follows the usual major.minor.patch scheme (0.4.0).

QuantifyPolyA 0.3.0

  • Last version distributed through SourceForge.
